no_adcom_quote.quote: No advisory committee meeting was held, and no external consultations were requested for this NDA.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for NDA216016 (IOMERVU, iomeprol). The Multidisciplinary Review's section 9 (Advisory Committee Meeting and Other External Consultations) states explicitly that no advisory committee meeting was held and no external consultations were requested. There are therefore no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
